subject: german
title: Family Foundations: Meine Familie
welcome_lead: Master the core family vocabulary — mother, father, siblings, grandparents — with the right articles.
meta_desc: GCSE German family vocab: core nouns with der/die/das articles and possessives.
final_note: Knowing the gender of each family member unlocks correct possessives: mein Bruder, meine Schwester.

concepts.def: Mother — feminine noun; my mother = meine Mutter.
Father — masculine; my father = mein Vater.
Brother — masculine; plural is die Brüder.
Sister — feminine; plural is die Schwestern.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Every German noun has a gender. For family:

  • der (m): der Vater, der Bruder, der Großvater, der Sohn, der Onkel
  • die (f): die Mutter, die Schwester, die Großmutter, die Tochter, die Tante
  • das (n): das Kind (the child), das Baby

mein for masculine/neuter, meine for feminine and plural.

Examples: mein Vater, meine Mutter, mein Bruder, meine Schwester, meine Eltern (my parents).

Same pattern: dein/deine (your, informal).

Useful phrases:

  • Ich habe einen Bruder — I have a brother.
  • Ich habe zwei Schwestern — I have two sisters.
  • Meine Familie ist groß/klein — My family is big/small.
  • Ich bin Einzelkind — I'm an only child.
